scope: Factual audit of the existing achievement-diary and PvM-foundation records. Covers permanent or repeatable Ironman-useful diary rewards, claim gates, quest dependencies, and fixed tier lamps. It does not rank diaries, recommend an order, or generate a route.

facts_included: documented quest, skill, item, currency, and encounter gates
fixed lamps and permanent/repeatable reward mechanics
explicit corrections and omissions in the prior four-record foundation

existing_foundation_audit.finding: The four original records are directionally correct but are not sufficient to model diary or PvM dependencies. They omit several durable rewards, exact tier gates, task-specific quest dependencies, and two important PvM access conditions.

retained_claims: Easy tier grants daily rune-free low-alchemy casts.
Hard tier increases Tears of Guthix experience.
Elite tier removes the Dramen/Lunar staff requirement at fairy rings.
missing_factual_coverage: the exact per-tier restore, teleport, and alchemy quantities
the hard-tier Bones to Peaches, Lost City, and skill gates
the elite Slayer-block-slot and Culinomancer's Chest effects

retained_claims: Easy tier doubles the stated Xeric's talisman drop chance from qualifying lizardmen.
Easy tier makes the Hosidius herb patches disease-free.
Hard tier adds a 5% chance to save a harvest life at the Hosidius and Farming Guild herb patches.
missing_factual_coverage: Mount Karuulm teleports and hard-tier quest/combat gates
the exact Rada's blessing fishing chance

retained_claims: Piety is obtained through King's Ransom and the Knight Waves Training Grounds.
missing_factual_coverage: Knight Waves Training Grounds also requires 70 Defence; both stated combat-skill requirements are not boostable.
King's Ransom and its prerequisite chain remain hard quest dependencies.

retained_claims: A Rune defender must be shown to Lorelai before basement Cyclopes can drop the Dragon defender.
The stated Dragon defender rate is 1 in 100 from the level-106 basement Cyclopes.
60 Defence is required to equip it.
missing_factual_coverage: Warriors' Guild entry requires either 130 combined Attack and Strength or level 99 in either skill.
The original record does not distinguish the deterministic access chain from the variable defender drops.

records.name: Achievement Diary tier claim rule and fixed lamps

requirements.claim_rule: A tier's reward is claimable only after every task in that tier and all preceding tiers of that diary are complete. Tasks themselves may be completed out of order.
requirements.boosting_rule: Temporary skill boosts are permitted unless an individual task explicitly marks its requirement as not boostable.

records.guarantee: Each lamp is a fixed reward once its tier is validly claimed; it is not a drop-roll result.

records.name: Dragon defender access and RNG distinction

requirements.warriors_guild_entry: Either 130 combined Attack and Strength, or level 99 in Attack or Strength.
requirements.basement_access: Show a Rune defender to Lorelai.

mechanics.deterministic_access_chain: Warriors' Guild entry and Lorelai's basement permission are deterministic once their requirements are met.
mechanics.variable_acquisition: Dragon defenders are a 1 in 100 drop from the level-106 basement Cyclopes. The preceding Bronze-through-Rune defender drops are each 1 in 50 from top-floor Cyclopes.
mechanics.token_consumption: Warriors' Guild tokens are consumed while inside unless an Attack cape is worn.
